sn22.100:1.3: pubbakoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānam taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsārataṃ || || 4
sn22.100:1.4: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave sā gaddulabaddho daḷhe khīle vā thambe vā upanibaddho || so gacchati ce pi tam eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upagacchati || tiṭṭhati ce pi tam eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upatiṭṭhati || nisīdati ce pi taṃ eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upanisīdati || nippajjati ce pi tam eva khīlam vā thambhaṃ vā upanippajjati || || 5
sn22.100:1.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano Rūpam etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti samanupassati || ||
sn22.100:1.9: Viññāṇam etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti samanupassati || ||
sn22.100:1.10: So gacchati ce pi ime pañcupādānakkhandhe upagacchati ||
sn22.100:1.11: tiṭṭhati ce pi ime pañcupādānakkhandhe upatiṭṭhati ||
sn22.100:1.12: nisīdati ce pi ime pañcupādānakkhandhe upanisīdati ||
sn22.100:1.13: nippajjati ce pi ime pañcupādānakkhandhe upanippajjati || || 6
sn22.100:1.14: Tasmātiha bhikkhave abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
sn22.100:1.15: Dīgharattam idaṃ cittaṃ saṃkiliṭṭham rāgena dosena mohenā ti || ||
sn22.100:2.1: Diṭṭhaṃ vo bhikkhave caraṇaṃ nāma cittanti || ||
sn22.100:2.3: Tam pi kho bhikkhave caranaṃ nāma cittaṃ citteneva cintitaṃ || tena pi kho bhikkhave caraṇena cittena cittaññeva cittataraṃ || || 8
sn22.100:2.4: Tasmātiha bhikkhave abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ ||
sn22.100:2.5: Dīgharattam idam cittaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenāti || ||
sn22.100:3.1: Nāham bhikkhave aññam ekanikāyaṃ pi samanupassāmi evaṃcittaṃ yathayidam bhikkhave tiracchānagatā pāṇā
sn22.100:3.2: te pi kho bhikkhave tiracchānagatā pāṇā citteneva cittatā || || Tehi pi kho bhikkhave tiracchānagatehi pāṇehi cittaññeva cittataraṃ || || 10
sn22.100:3.3: Tasmātiha bhikkhave bhikkhunā abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittam paccavekkhitabbaṃ
sn22.100:3.4: Dīgharattam idaṃ cittaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenāti || ||
sn22.100:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya va haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjeṭṭhiyā vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ||
sn22.100:4.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano rūpaññeva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti || vedanaññeva || pe || saññaññeva || saṅkhāreva || viññāṇaṃ yeva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti || || 12
sn22.100:4.4: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
